assets.title: Low Corner-Seat Sandpit
assets.description: One original low-wide chamfered sandpit, counted as one complete static visual prop. A continuous thick octagonal pit has a full 60 mm floor and eight low walls. A separate closed 100 mm sand layer sits over its entire bottom on that floor, with a positive continuous side clearance and a flat subtly colour-faceted top below the rim. Four broad thick bevel-edged corner seat plates span both adjacent low walls, with their complete finite bearing regions opposed to the actual rim and with the remaining underside visibly open above the sand. Six editable closed meshes and four constant opaque PBR colours; metres, native Z up, front -Y and bounds-centred ground origin. No scene ground, people, tools, toys, sand castle, particles, physics or animation. All low basin, sand and corner-seat geometry is newly authored, not a resized planter, recoloured roundabout or extracted old bench. Fixed static visual arrangement only: no child suitability, human fit, seating performance, load, strength, stability, fall protection, hygiene, sand safety, capacity, standard depth, manufacture, installation compatibility or public-safety certification.
